steps.en: Install a release build (or build from source) and open a layered PSD
steps.zh: 装发布版（或从源码编译），打开一个分层 PSD

steps.en: Reads it into its own layer model and carries unmodelled blocks instead of dropping them
steps.zh: 读进自己的图层模型，认不出的数据块原样带着走而不丢弃

steps.en: Edit with familiar menus and shortcuts: adjustment layers, masks, layer styles, type
steps.zh: 用熟悉的菜单和快捷键编辑：调整图层、蒙版、图层样式、文字

steps.en: Runs every click as a named command and redraws the layer stack live on the GPU
steps.zh: 每次点击都执行一条具名命令，在显卡上实时重绘图层栈

steps.en: Save back to PSD, or Export As PNG/JPEG
steps.zh: 存回 PSD，或导出为 PNG／JPEG

steps.en: Writes a layered PSD that re-opens with the same render for 307 of 309 corpus files
steps.zh: 写出分层 PSD，测试集 309 个文件里 307 个重开后渲染一致

value.en: You edit and hand back layered PSDs offline without a Photoshop subscription, as long as the file stays inside what it models
value.zh: 不用订阅 Photoshop、离线就能改分层 PSD 再交回去，前提是文件没超出它支持的范围
